title: Falling
description: A falling camera drops the lens through air with weight and wind, a body or viewpoint in free fall. Gravity is the path: the ground rises, air rushes, and the horizon may not stay polite.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Gravity is the plot. A jump, a slip, a body leaving a roof: the shot lasts as long as the drop, often a few seconds, and the camera either falls with the subject or is the subject.
A crane down is not a fall. If the arm is supported and the speed is chosen, you have a boom, not weight.
A drone that eases down is also not this shot.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: The camera is dropped, thrown, or flown on a path that accelerates downward: wire, descender, or a digital fall with the same acceleration. Wide or moderate-wide helps the ground grow.
Prompt: Falling camera with [Subject], the lens dropping through air, weight, and wind, a body or viewpoint in free fall. Video: six seconds of drop, rushing air, ground rising.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when the beat is a drop: a leap, a slip, a body leaving structure. Do not use it as a stylish way to enter a lobby.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: An FPV Drone can fall, but it can also turn, climb, and thread. Falling is committed to gravity.
Ground Level is a height at the end, not the drop. A Crane Down is a supported boom with chosen speed.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Walk puts viewpoint and body into air above a city. Point Break uses freefall as the scene, not as a garnish.
Grammar: weight, wind, ground rising.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a crane down or a drone descend. The tell: constant speed, stable horizon, no sense of weight.
The fix: accelerate down, let the ground rise, add wind and a short duration.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Falling in film?
A falling camera drops through air under gravity, with the ground rising and wind in the frame. The path is a fall, not a supported boom.
Falling vs Crane Down
A crane down is a chosen, supported descent. Falling accelerates with weight; the camera is in free fall with or as the body.
When should I use Falling?
Use it when gravity is the beat: a jump, a slip, a drop from a roof. Do not use it to enter a room in style.
How do I prompt Falling for AI image or video?
Write a drop, rushing air, and ground rising. Example: Falling camera with [Subject], the lens dropping through air, weight, and wind, a body or viewpoint in free fall.
